'''ULJK Group'''<ref>{{cite web|title=ULJK GROUP|url=http://www.uljk.in/uljk.pdf|website=www.uljk.in|publisher=ULJK}}</ref> is a [[Financial Institution]] Company, located at [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE), [[Dalal Street]], [[Kala Ghoda]], [[Mumbai]] (formerly Bombay), [[Maharashtra]], [[India]]. The company was established in the year 1903.<ref>{{cite web|title=About Uljk|url=http://www.uljk.in/uljk/about-us.html|website=www.uljk.in}}</ref> The group name '''ULJK''' stands for the four generations who contributed in creating and developing the organization – '''''Umesh Vora''''', '''''Laldas Vora''''', '''''Jamnadas Vora''''' and '''''Khushaldas Vora'''''.

== History ==

Based out of the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] towers, ULJK GROUP has 113 years old history with respect to providing financial services and advisory. The company was established in the year 1903. Laldas Vora,<ref>{{cite news|title=Budget has failed to address itself to immediate needs|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/magazine/economy/story/19830331-budget-has-failed-to-address-itself-to-immediate-needs-770577-2013-07-24|publisher=India Today|date=24 July 2013}}</ref><ref name="sebi">{{cite web|url=http://www.sebi.gov.in/History/HistoryBSEBoardMeeting.pdf|website=Securities And Exchange Board Of India|date=20 February 1973|title=SEBI }}</ref> late partner was the President of [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] for 9 years and had contributed in overseeing the construction of the Bombay Stock Exchange Tower. ULJK Group is now in its 5th family generation of serving the [[financial services]] community.{{citation needed|date=November 2018}}

=== Headquarters ===

ULJK's headquarters is located in Stock Exchange Towers ([[Bombay Stock Exchange]]), [[Dalal Street]], Fort, Mumbai.
